message: You know, I’ve always admired those folks who seem to have everything together when it comes to preparedness. This year, I decided it was time to be the one who’s ready! I stumbled upon a fantastic resource that helps you create a family emergency plan. It's really comforting to know that there’s a simple way to think through things and make sure everyone is on the same page. It’s like having a cozy safety net, just in case! 🛡️ Have you thought about your own plan lately?
